profile_text.body:
OctoAI is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, USA, according to the company profile. Its website is octo.ai.

The text harvested from the site does not describe OctoAI. It consists of material about NVIDIA, covering accelerated computing, GPUs, AI models such as NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard, RTX and GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs, the Jetson and Isaac platforms, and events. One passage states that Deci was acquired by NVIDIA Corporation of Santa Clara, CA in May 2024 and was dissolved as a separate corporate entity. No OctoAI products are tracked in the record.

The record lists no lawsuits and no MCP servers for OctoAI. It records a law exposure entry for Washington with a count of 114.
